name: TheySaid 4.0
tagline: See how users will react, right where you build.
description: Put what you’re building in front of real customers or synthetic users trained on them when you need an answer in minutes without leaving Claude, Cursor, or Jira. Nothing ships on a guess.

name: Overmind
tagline: Open-source platform for continuous learning
description: Overmind is the model training platform for AI teams. Turn your production traces into specialised models you own, trained, benchmarked, and served.

name: Spacesheep
tagline: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team
description: Spacesheep (YC F26) turns any agent's work into a space: an interactive doc, live dashboard, mockup or app. Share it with specific people, your team or publicly, and collaborate on it together.

name: Orbit
tagline: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock.
description: Doomscrolling is free. Orbit makes it cost something. Pick a schedule and your apps lock themselves. Want back in early? Earn it: hold the orb, do squats, ask a friend, pay a little more each time, or win a shift at The Gate. Most times, you’ll stay out.

name: SavorApp_AI
tagline: Capture what matters and move your intentions forward
description: Savor is an Intention Layer™ for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Speak, type, or snap a photo to create a clear card in Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring it back when it matters. Take Action (Beta) helps you explore options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. Review and adjust as you go. Hand off a card or a single step, with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next. Free on iOS and Android.

name: Notra
tagline: Notra is a GEO tool that helps you rank in AI Search.
description: Notra is a GEO tool that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the questions your buyers ask. It shows whether you appear, who appears instead and how to fix it.

name: Nuvio 5.0
tagline: Hand your financial admin to your AI agent
description: Automate invoicing, expenses and reconciliation. Ask Nuvio’s assistant to do the work, or connect ChatGPT, Claude or your own AI agent. We’re also adding bookkeeping and tax services with accountants who already know Nuvio.

name: PulseDev
tagline: Click any UI bug on localhost and your AI agent fixes it
description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.

name: iPad mini 8
tagline: OLED, A20 Pro and IP67 in Apple's smallest iPad
description: The all new iPad mini. Featuring the 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display with OLED, A20 Pro chip, Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. Supports Apple Pencil.

name: Arcade Controller Pro
tagline: A fight controller with no stick and its own screen
description: A customizable all-button arcade controller with a compact layout, built-in display, hot-swappable switches, RGB lighting, and a magnetic wrist rest.

name: NuPlay
tagline: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform
description: NuPlay runs AI agents for enterprises in production that improve after every run. Deploy agents for retail, customer service, consumer goods etc., across voice, chat, and email, connected to your existing systems. NuPlay is built as one platform, has 5 layers which build, run and improve the agents: NuPro, NuStack, NuContext, Nupulse and NuLoop.

name: fswitcher
tagline: fswitcher replaces Command-Tab on your Mac
description: fswitcher is for power users who want more out of cmd+tab. fswitcher looks, feels, and behaves exactly like you expect, but handles apps, windows, desktops, and multiple displays naturally.

name: Revix AI
tagline: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules
description: Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

name: Off Grid AI
tagline: Private AI on your phone and computer.
description: Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

name: Paddock
tagline: Computers and sandboxes for your agents
description: Paddock gives each AI agent its own Linux computer or a locked-down sandbox, on one VPS you own. Free and open source, MIT licensed.

name: OpenRadView
tagline: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays
description: OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

name: GPT-6.1 Terra
tagline: Fast, capable computer use at half the price
description: GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's fast, efficient model for visual reasoning, precise computer use and natural writing. It reads what's on screen, takes action across apps, and handles workday tasks like filling out forms, interpreting technical drawings and drafting proposals. OpenAI says it matches GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam at one tenth the price per token and finishes tasks over 3x faster. Available now in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra.

name: Coachare
tagline: Your potential. Unlocked.
description: Coachare is an AI-powered coaching platform that helps managers and leaders grow. Practice difficult conversations, performance reviews, and negotiations with an AI counterpart that challenges you in real time. Get actionable feedback, sharpen your communication, and build confidence. Coachare remembers your goals, tracks your progress, and connects you with expert human coaches when you need deeper guidance. You stay in control of what you share.

name: NINX
tagline: Private On-device AI, connected tools, & creative workflows
description: NINX is an AI workspace for getting things done using on-device models. Run models on your device or bring your own API key. Talk to your AI, connect apps, code with Codex, automate recurring tasks, and create videos in Studio. Capture conversations in Notes, collaborate in Rooms, and take your workflows mobile with Ningenie.

name: ContextGem 1.0
tagline: Decision models join LLMs to extract data from documents
description: New in 1.0: decision models next to LLMs. They answer closed questions with the probability of each answer, fast and at a low cost, and a model group sends each question to the model that suits it. Also new: Docling for your files, and tools for agents.
